blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Single-image 3D generation has achieved high fidelity on curated benchmarks, yet degrades sharply on real-world images with uneven illumination, blur, and occlusions. Purifying such inputs requires deciding when to intervene and preserving the visual cues needed for 3D generation, while leaving clean inputs unchanged. We introduce Gate3DGen, a selective pre-processing model that gates image inputs to existing 3D generators without retraining them. A degradation-aware router bypasses inputs classified as clean and extracts features to guide purification of the remaining inputs. Conditioned on these features, a 3D-oriented one-step purifier purifies degraded inputs with spatial losses that encourage preservation of object identity, contours, and textural cues. To provide paired supervision, we construct a synthetic data engine that renders clean views of 3D assets and synthesises composite degradations. On the synthetic benchmark, the purifier improves image fidelity and downstream 3D geometry in only 2.3s on average, reducing TRELLIS.2 mesh distance by 61.5% relative to degraded inputs. VLM evaluation and human preferences on real photographs further support identity preservation and degradation correction. More demos and code are available at https://supra-3d.github.io/gate3dgen.
blocks.zh: 单像3D一代在编译的基准上实现了高度的忠诚,然而在现实世界的图像上却以不均匀的光线,模糊,和杂乱无章地急剧退化. 净化这种投入需要决定何时进行干预,并保留3D生成所需的视觉提示,同时保持清洁投入不变。 我们引入了Gate3DGen,一种选择性的预处理模型,在不进行再培训的情况下将图像输入到现有的3D发电机上. 降解感路由器绕过归类为清洁的输入并提取特性,以指导其余输入的净化. 以这些特征为条件,一个面向3D的单步净化器净化了已退化的输入,造成空间损失,鼓励保存物体的特征、轮廓和纹理提示。 为了提供配对监督,我们建造了一个合成数据引擎,使三维资产得到干净的视野,合成合成降解。 在合成基准上,净化器平均仅用2.3s改进图像忠贞度和下游3D几何,相对于退化的输入物,TRELLIS.2网间距离减少了61.5%. VLM评价以及人类对真实照片的偏好进一步支持身份保存和降解矫正. 可在https://supra-3d.github.io/gate3dgen上查阅更多演示和代码。

blocks.en: 1  Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Single-image 3D generative models have achieved remarkable progress on curated benchmarks ( Hong et al., 2024 ; Tochilkin et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2024 ; Xiang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) , yet degrade sharply on real-world images.
This vulnerability stems from restrictive assumptions about input images. Contemporary models assume centered, sharp, and fully visible objects under uniform studio lighting ( Xu et al., 2024 ; Xiang et al., 2025 ; Xiang et al., 2026 ) .
In real-world scenarios, however, unconstrained photographs routinely exhibit blur, uneven illumination, or occlusions ( Cho et al., 2025 ; Qu et al., 2026 ) , corrupting visual cues and inducing severe artifacts in 3D outputs.
blocks.zh:
单像3D基因模型在曲谱基准上取得了显著进展(Hong等人,2024年;Tochilkin等人,2024年;徐等人,2024年;Xiang等人,2026年;Li等人,2026年;Yang等人,2026年),但在现实世界的影像上却急剧下降.
这种脆弱性源于对输入图像的限制性假设。 当代模型假设在统一工作室照明下有中心,尖锐,全可见的物体(徐等,2024年;X等,2025年;X等,2026年).
然而,在现实世界的情景中,不受约束的照片通常会表现出模糊、不均匀的光照,或隐蔽(Cho等人,2025年;Qu等人,2026年),腐蚀视觉提示和诱导3D输出中的严重文物。

blocks.en:
Open-source image-to-3D pipelines commonly use background removal and recentering ( Tochilkin et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2024 ; Xiang et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ) , which do not directly address photometric corruptions or foreground occlusions.
Specialized preprocessing also targets individual factors such as illumination through delighting ( Li et al., 2025a ; Zhao et al., 2025 ) .
When multiple degradations coexist, correcting one factor can leave other sources of ambiguity in the conditioning image.
Our comparisons show that generic 2D image editing can alter object appearance or contours, with adverse effects on downstream geometry (Section 4.4 ).
The objective is therefore to recover a suitable observation of the same object, retaining the visible structural evidence that the 3D generator uses to infer shape and appearance.
This motivates selective input purification that preserves visual cues for 3D generation while avoiding unnecessary changes to already suitable clean inputs.
blocks.zh:
开源影像至3D管道通常采用背景清除和近代化(Tochilkin等人,2024年;徐等人,2024年;Xiang等人,2025年;Zhao等人,2025年),不直接处理光度腐败或前缘隐蔽.
专门预处理还针对个别因素,例如通过取悦进行照明(Li等人,2025a); 赵等,2025).
当多重降解并存时,纠正一个因子可能会在条件图像中留下其他模糊的来源.
我们的比较表明,通用的2D图像编辑可以改变对象的外观或轮廓,对下游几何产生不利影响(第4.4节)。
因此,目标是恢复对同一物体的适当观测,保留3D生成器用来推断形状和外观的可见结构证据.
这激励了选择性输入净化,为3D生成保留视觉提示,同时避免对已经合适的清洁输入进行不必要的修改.

blocks.en:
We therefore introduce Gate3DGen, a selective pre-processing model that gates real-world images to existing 3D generators (Figure ).
It routes each image through purification or an unchanged bypass, keeping the downstream generators frozen.
Gate3DGen couples a degradation-aware router with a 3D-oriented one-step purifier .
The router bypasses inputs classified as clean and selects the remaining inputs for purification, while extracting continuous degradation-aware features for the purifier.
Conditioned on these features, the one-step purifier purifies degraded inputs in a single forward pass to reduce inference cost, with spatial losses that encourage preservation of object identity and essential geometric and textural cues.
Training requires matched ground-truth references, which are unavailable for real-world images.
To provide paired training supervision without manual collection, we construct a synthetic data engine from 3D assets.
Rendering multi-view anchors from 3,961 3D assets ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) and synthesizing composite corruptions (e.g., uneven illumination, blur, and occlusions) yields 43,936 aligned image pairs and 1,082 held-out cases with 3D ground truth.
blocks.zh:
因此,我们引入了Gate3DGen,一种选择性的预处理模型,将真实世界的图像连接到现有的3D生成器(图).
它通过净化或没有改变的绕行来传递每个图像,保持下游发电机的冻结.
Gate3DGen夫妇使用3D导向单步净化器的降解感路由器。
路由器绕过分类为干净的输入,选择其余的输入进行净化,同时为净化器提取持续降解感知特性.
单步净化器以这些特征为条件,在单一的前进通道中净化已退化的投入,以减少推论成本,空间损失鼓励保留物体特征和基本的几何和纹理提示。
培训需要相应的地面实况参考资料,而真实世界的图像则无法提供。
为了在不人工收集的情况下提供配对培训监督,我们从3D资产中构建了合成数据引擎.
从3,961个3D资产(张等人,2025年)中渲染多景主播,合成复合腐败(如不均匀的照明,模糊不清,以及隐蔽),得出43,936对对齐的图像对和1,082个持有3D地面真相的搁置案件.

blocks.en:
We evaluate the purifier on this synthetic benchmark with two pretrained 3D generative models, TRELLIS.2 ( Xiang et al., 2026 ) and Pixal3D ( Li et al., 2026 ) .
For 2D purification, Gate3DGen reduces foreground LPIPS by 39.1 % 39.1\% while preserving subject silhouettes, with an inference time of 2.3 2.3 s per image. In comparison, the image editing baselines require 15.6 15.6 – 100.8 100.8 s per image and can alter object identity and reduce reconstruction fidelity (Table 2 ).
When used to condition these 3D generative models, the purified images consistently improve all geometry and appearance metrics over the original observations.
Specifically, Gate3DGen achieves a 61.5 % 61.5\% reduction in all-surface mesh distance, closes 55.5 % 55.5\% of the geometry gap to clean references on average (up to 83.1 % 83.1\% on TRELLIS.2), and reduces rendering LPIPS by 10.9 % 10.9\% .
Evaluated separately, the degradation-aware router identifies degraded inputs with 88.45 % 88.45\% recall and 93.47 % 93.47\% specificity on clean inputs, sending inputs classified as degraded for purification.
On real photographs, VLM scores and human preferences further support identity preservation and degradation correction, complementing the reference-based evaluation on synthetic inputs.
blocks.zh:
我们用两个预先训练过的3D基因模型来评价这个合成基准上的净化剂,TRELLIS2(Xiang等人,2026年)和Pixal3D(Li等人,2026年).
对于2D纯化,Gate3DGen在保留主题圆筒的同时将前缘LPIPS减少39.1% 39.1\%,推断时间为每幅图像2.3秒. 相比之下,图像编辑基线需要15.6 15.6 – 100.8 100.8 s每幅图像,可以改变对象身份,降低重建的忠诚度(表2).
当用来为这些3D基因模型作条件时,纯洁的图像会比原始观测结果不断改进所有几何和外观的度量.
具体来说,Gate3DGen实现全表网间距缩小61.5%,将55.5%的几何差距拉近到平均清洁参考(TRELLIS2上最高83.1%的83.1%),将渲染LPIPS减少10.9%。
对降解意识路由器进行了单独评估,确定了退化的投入,88.45%召回,93.47%对清洁投入进行了特异性评估,发送的输入被归类为退化用于净化。
在真实照片上,VLM分数和人类偏好进一步支持身份保存和降解校正,是对合成投入的参考评价的补充.

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: • We formulate robust single-image 3D generation as selective input purification, improving existing 3D generators through purified inputs without retraining them. • We introduce Gate3DGen, combining a router that bypasses inputs classified as clean with a one-step purifier. Degradation-aware features and spatial losses guide purification toward preserving object identity, contours, and geometric and textural cues for downstream 3D generation. • We construct a synthetic data engine providing paired purification supervision from 3D assets and a benchmark with 3D ground truth for 3D evaluation. Our method reduces foreground LPIPS by 39.1 % 39.1\% and TRELLIS.2 mesh distance by 61.5 % 61.5\% relative to degraded inputs, demonstrating gains in image fidelity and downstream 3D geometry.

blocks.en: 2  Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Robustness in Single-Image 3D Generation. Modern single-image 3D methods, including feed-forward reconstruction and iterative diffusion or flow models, achieve high fidelity on curated inputs ( Hong et al., 2024 ; Tochilkin et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2024 ; Boss et al., 2025 ; Xiang et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025b ; Lai et al., 2025 ; Xiang et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) .
Blur, uneven illumination, and occlusions can reduce their generation quality.
Common input preprocessing operations include foreground segmentation and recentering, which do not directly correct illumination, blur, or foreground occlusions.
Specialized methods address illumination through lighting decomposition or delighting ( Li et al., 2025a ; Lai et al., 2025 ) .
Related work investigates recovery of occluded geometry through volumetric reconstruction or multi-view synthesis ( Cho et al., 2025 ; Qu et al., 2026 ; Shi et al., 2025 ) .
Our work focuses on selective input purification before frozen 3D generators, addressing composite degradations involving uneven illumination, blur, and occlusions.
blocks.zh:
强力在单像3D世代. 现代单像3D方法,包括饲料向前重建以及迭代传播或流量模型,在配方投入上实现高度忠诚(Hong等人,2024年;Tochilkin等人,2024年;Xu等人,2024年;Boss等人,2025年;Xiang等人,2025年;赵等人,2025年;Li等人,2025年b;Lai等人,2025年;Xiang等人,2026年b;Wu等人,2026年b;Li等人,2026年b;Yang等人,2026年).
模糊,不均匀的照明,和杂化可以降低其生成质量.
常见的输入预处理操作包括前缘分解和近缘分解,它们不直接纠正照明,模糊,或前缘隐蔽.
专门方法通过照明分解或取悦处理照明问题(Li等人,2025a;Lai等人,2025年)。
相关工作调查通过体积重建或多视合成恢复几何特征(Cho等人,2025年;Qu等人,2026年;Shi等人,2025年)。
我们的工作重点是在冷冻3D发电机之前进行选择性输入净化,处理涉及不均匀照明、模糊和隔离的综合降解。

blocks.en:
2D Image Editing and Degradation Routing. Recent advances in instruction-guided editing ( Black Forest Labs et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026a ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Qiao et al., 2026 ) and all-in-one restoration ( Potlapalli et al., 2023 ; Conde et al., 2024 ; Lin et al., 2023 ; Yu et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2024 ) synthesize visually compelling images.
Their objectives do not explicitly measure downstream 3D fidelity.
In our comparisons, generic image editing methods can remove visible degradations while changing object appearance or contours, with adverse effects on downstream geometry (Section 4.4 ).
Editing clean photographs can introduce unwanted changes, motivating selective restoration. No-reference quality metrics ( Mittal et al., 2013 ; Yang et al., 2022 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ) and general vision-language models ( You et al., 2024 ; Bai et al., 2025 ; OpenAI, 2026b ) provide candidate quality signals, but their suitability for routing requires evaluation (Section 4.2 ).
Gate3DGen couples a degradation-aware router with a one-step purifier to preserve identity and contours while selectively purifying inputs.
blocks.zh:
2D 图像编辑与退化运行. 指导性编辑的最新进展(黑林实验室等人,2025年;吴等人,2025年;吴等人,2026年a;刘等人,2025年;张等人,2026年;廖等人,2026年)和全方位修复(波特拉帕利等人,2023年;康德等人,2024年;林等人,2023年;余等人,2024年;郭等人,2024年)合成了视觉引人入胜的图像.
其目标没有明确衡量下游3D忠诚度.
在我们的比较中,通用图像编辑方法可以在改变物体外观或轮廓的同时去除可见降解,对下游几何产生不良影响(第4.4节).
编辑干净的照片可以引入不想要的更改,激发选择性恢复. 无参考质量衡量标准(Mittal等人,2013年;Yang等人,2022年;Zhang等人,2023年)和一般视觉语言模型 (You等人, 2024年;Bai等人, 2025年;OpenAI, 2026b )提供候选质量信号,但是其适合路由需要评价(第4.2节)。
Gate3DGen夫妇是具有降解意识的路由器,带有单步净化器,以保持身份和轮廓,同时有选择地净化投入.

3.2  Synthetic Data Engine
blocks.zh: 3.2 合成数据引擎

blocks.en:
Learning 𝒞 θ \mathcal{C}_{\theta} requires paired images ( x i o , x i c ) (x^{o}_{i},x^{c}_{i}) that share identical 3D geometry and viewpoints while differing only in capture quality, whereas learning ℛ ϕ \mathcal{R}_{\phi} requires examples labeled by whether purification is necessary.
Because real photographs provide neither matched clean counterparts nor controlled routing labels, we use high-fidelity 3D assets to construct this supervision (Figure 1 A).

由于真实的照片既不能提供匹配的清洁对等物,也不能提供受控的路由标签,所以我们使用高纯度的3D资产来构建这种监督(图1 A).

A vision-language model (VLM) ranks these views by geometric visibility and self-occlusion.
The four most informative views per asset serve as multi-view anchors and matched clean references x i c x^{c}_{i} .

blocks.en:
Table 1 reports routing results on 1,082 1,082{} degraded and 934 934{} clean synthetic inputs and on 96 96{} in-the-wild images. Because real photographs lack explicit routing labels, a GPT-5 agent assigns proxy Purify / Keep labels by comparing multi-view renderings and no-reference metrics for 3D assets generated from the unedited and purified images by Pixal3D and TRELLIS.2.
The router should direct degraded inputs to the purifier and leave clean inputs unchanged, as uncorrected degradations can introduce geometric artifacts (Table 3 ). On the synthetic benchmark , the router attains 88.45 % 88.45\% recall and 90.77 % 90.77\% accuracy, yielding the highest H \mathrm{H} of 89.59 % 89.59\% , which exceeds the strongest baseline, MANIQA ( Yang et al., 2022 ) , by 5.55 5.55 percentage points.
NIQE ( Mittal et al., 2013 ) , mPLUG-Owl2 ( Ye et al., 2023 ) , and DepictQA-Wild ( You et al., 2024 ) exceed 98 % 98\% recall, but their accuracies remain within one percentage point of the 53.7 % 53.7\% obtained by outputting Purify for all inputs, resulting in H \mathrm{H} values of only 69.19 69.19 – 70.23 % 70.23\% .
MANIQA attains 89.04 % 89.04\% accuracy but only 79.57 % 79.57\% recall. Our router improves both, indicating that its higher H \mathrm{H} reflects better detection of inputs needing purification alongside more accurate routing overall.
Zero-shot Qwen2.5-VL, which shares the backbone of our router, reaches H = 78.64 % \mathrm{H}=78.64\% . Training on 𝒟 route \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{route}} raises recall by 4.81 4.81 percentage points and accuracy by 16.56 16.56 points, improving H \mathrm{H} by 10.95 10.95 points. On the in-the-wild benchmark , the router ranks second in H \mathrm{H} ( 70.56 % 70.56\% ), with 89.29 % 89.29\% recall and 58.33 % 58.33\% accuracy against the proxy labels.
DepictQA-Wild achieves the highest H \mathrm{H} ( 73.68 % 73.68\% ), but its 100 % 100\% recall and 58.33 % 58.33\% accuracy match the strategy of always predicting Purify .
Thus, a high H \mathrm{H} alone does not establish effective preservation of Keep inputs, and our router does not outperform this trivial strategy under the real-image proxy protocol.
The high recall and lower accuracy are consistent with over-routing of inputs labeled Keep to purification. This gap may reflect the use of clean renders for the Keep class in 𝒟 route \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{route}} . Whether adding real photographs to this class improves routing remains to be tested.

blocks.en: 5  Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
Trained on image pairs synthesized from 3D assets, Gate3DGen combines a degradation-aware router and a 3D-oriented one-step purifier before frozen 3D generators.
On 1,082 cases, its purifier outperforms seven image editing methods in image fidelity and surface geometry for TRELLIS.2 and Pixal3D, closing up to 83.1 % 83.1\% of the mesh-distance gap to clean-reference inputs.
VLM scores and human preferences on real photographs support identity preservation and degradation correction.
Ablations and real-image comparisons motivate evaluating purification through downstream surface geometry, rendered appearance, and object fidelity beyond image similarity or visual quality alone.
blocks.zh:
Gate3DGen从3D资产合成的图像对上进行训练,在冷冻3D发电机前结合了降解感知路由器和面向3D的单步净化器.
在1,082个案例中,其纯度超过TRELLIS.2和Pixal3D图像忠度和表面几何的7个图像编辑方法,关闭了83.1%的网间距缺口,以进行清洁参考输入。
VLM得分和真照片上的人类偏好支持身份保存和降解修正.
虚构和真实图像比较促使人们通过下游地表几何来评价纯度,使外观和物体忠贞性超越图像相似性或视觉质量。

blocks.en: Appendix C Relative Performance across 2D and 3D Metrics
blocks.zh: 附录C 相对 2D和3D计量仪的性能

blocks.en:
Figure 3 provides a unified view of the 2D purification metrics in Table 2 and the downstream TRELLIS.2 metrics in Table 3 .
The observed degraded input is the zero reference and the matched clean input is the oracle reference at one. The direction of lower-is-better metrics is reversed so that larger radial values consistently indicate better performance.
Among the representative editing baselines shown, Gate3DGen makes positive progress toward the clean oracle on every metric.
In contrast, FireRed, GPT Image-2.5 Flare, and Mage-Flow exhibit negative changes on several 2D fidelity or fine-grained 3D geometry measures, illustrating the trade-off between visible degradation removal and preservation of reconstruction cues.
